property.name: value
property.description-key: The Yes/No (two options) column this control replaces. Place this control directly on that column.

property.name: displayStyle
property.description-key: How the Yes/No value is shown and changed

value.name: Checkbox
value.description-key: A checkbox, checked for Yes

value.name: Toggle
value.description-key: A switch, on for Yes (default). Shows no icons

value.name: LabeledSwitch
value.description-key: A switch with the current label inside the track and the icon inside the thumb

value.name: Radio
value.description-key: Two classic radio buttons, one per option

value.name: Buttons
value.description-key: Two separate buttons, one per option; the selected one is highlighted

value.name: Segmented
value.description-key: Both options in one field, the selected one highlighted like a chip

value.name: ToggleButton
value.description-key: A single button that is shown pressed for Yes, e.g. Favourite or Urgent

value.name: Chip
value.description-key: A single chip showing the current option with its icon and color; click it to switch

value.name: Icon
value.description-key: A single icon button, for example a star or a flag; click it to switch. The option label is shown as a tooltip

property.name: showLabels
property.description-key: Show the option labels of the column, e.g. Yes and No. Checkbox, Toggle, Labeled switch, Toggle button and Icon show the label of the current value; Radio buttons, Buttons and Segmented show one label per option

property.name: labelPosition
property.description-key: Checkbox, Toggle, Labeled switch and Icon only: whether the label sits to the right (default) or to the left of the control

value.name: Right
value.description-key: Label to the right of the control (default)

value.name: Left
value.description-key: Label to the left of the control

property.name: optionOrder
property.description-key: Buttons, Segmented and Radio buttons: which option comes first

value.name: YesFirst
value.description-key: Yes, then No (default)

value.name: NoFirst
value.description-key: No, then Yes

property.name: widthMode
property.description-key: Buttons, Segmented, Toggle button, Status chip and Radio buttons: whether they fill the available width (default) or have a fixed width. Checkbox, Toggle, Labeled switch and Icon are not affected

value.name: Fill
value.description-key: Fill the width of the field (default)

value.name: Fixed
value.description-key: Each button, segment, radio option or chip is Fixed width pixels wide, shrinking only when the field is narrower

property.name: fixedWidth
property.description-key: Width in pixels of each button, segment, radio option or chip when Width is Fixed

property.name: componentHeight
property.description-key: Height of the control, matching the other form fields

value.name: Tall
value.description-key: Standard height field

value.name: Short
value.description-key: Compact height field (default)

property.name: selectionShape
property.description-key: Corner shape of the buttons, segments, chip and checkbox

value.name: Square
value.description-key: Sharp corners

value.name: Rounded
value.description-key: Slightly rounded corners (default)

value.name: Round
value.description-key: Fully rounded ends

property.name: makeFontBold
property.description-key: Display the labels in bold font weight. The selected option of Buttons and Segmented is always bold

property.name: yesIcon
property.description-key: Optional icon for Yes: an MDL2 icon name (browse at https://www.flicon.io) or the name of a square image web resource, e.g. lops_Approved.svg. The Icon display style uses CompletedSolid (a check badge) when this is blank

property.name: noIcon
property.description-key: Optional icon for No: an MDL2 icon name or the name of a square image web resource. The Icon display style uses StatusErrorFull (a cancel badge) when this is blank

property.name: iconPosition
property.description-key: Position of the icon relative to its label. Above and Below apply to Buttons and Toggle button; the other styles treat them as Left and Right. Toggle shows no icons

value.name: Left
value.description-key: Icon to the left of the label (default)

value.name: Right
value.description-key: Icon to the right of the label

value.name: Above
value.description-key: Icon above the label (Buttons and Toggle button only)

value.name: Below
value.description-key: Icon below the label (Buttons and Toggle button only)

property.name: yesColor
property.description-key: Optional color of the Yes option (hex, e.g. #107C10), used wherever a color mode is set to Yes / No color. Yes/No columns have no option colors of their own. Blank uses the fallback color of each setting

property.name: noColor
property.description-key: Optional color of the No option (hex, e.g. #D13438), used wherever a color mode is set to Yes / No color. Blank uses the fallback color of each setting

property.name: iconColorMode
property.description-key: How MDL2 icon glyphs are colored: automatic contrast, a fixed color, the Yes color / No color (default), or a faded version of it. Image web resources are never recolored.

value.name: Auto
value.description-key: Icon color matches the text color for contrast

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Icon color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the Yes color or No color property (default)

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the Yes color or No color property

property.name: iconColor
property.description-key: Icon color for Fixed color mode, and when Yes color / No color is blank (hex, e.g. #255BA4)

property.name: checkedColorMode
property.description-key: Checkbox, Toggle, Labeled switch and Radio buttons: whether the fill when the value is Yes uses a custom color (default), the Yes color property, or a faded version of it

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Checked color property (default)

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the Yes color property

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the Yes color property

property.name: checkedColor
property.description-key: Checkbox, Toggle, Labeled switch and Radio buttons: fill when the value is Yes, for Custom color mode and when Yes color is blank (hex, e.g. #255BA4)

property.name: selectionBackgroundMode
property.description-key: Buttons, Segmented, Toggle button and Status chip: whether the background of the selected option uses a custom color, the Yes color / No color, or a faded version of it (default)

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Selection color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the Yes color or No color property

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the Yes color or No color property (default)

property.name: selectionColor
property.description-key: Background of the selected option for Custom color mode, and when Yes color / No color is blank (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB)

property.name: selectionBorderMode
property.description-key: Buttons, Segmented, Toggle button and Status chip: whether the selected option shows a border, and whether it uses a custom color or the Yes color / No color

value.name: Off
value.description-key: No border

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Selection border color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the Yes color or No color property (default)

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the Yes color or No color property

property.name: selectionBorderColor
property.description-key: Border of the selected option for Custom color mode, and when Yes color / No color is blank (hex, e.g. #255BA4)
